description: Defines IPC (Inter-Process Communication) connector interfaces, message serialization/deserialization, IPC channel and factory classes, including mechanisms for handling messages, responses, and state changes within the Thunder core namespace.

classes.name: IMessage
classes.description: Interface for messages with serialization/deserialization capabilities, including nested Serializer and Deserializer classes.

classes.name: IIPC
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC message with label, parameters, and response.

classes.name: IIPCServer
classes.description: Interface for IPC server procedures handling incoming messages.

classes.name: IPCMessageType
classes.description: Template class defining specific IPC message types with parameter and response serialization.

classes.name: IPCChannel
classes.description: Abstract class representing an IPC communication channel with registration, invocation, and response reporting.

classes.name: IPCChannelType
classes.description: Template class extending IPCChannel, managing message links, state, and extensions for specific source and extension types.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an IMessage into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into an IMessage.

methods.name: Procedure
methods.description: Handles incoming IPC procedures on the server side.

methods.name: ReportResponse
methods.description: Reports an IPC response back through the channel.
